units.rawText: My first encounter with the Professor was on a certain rainy night. During my livestream, a comment suddenly popped up saying: "Kuro, you're the best streamer ever." The sender? The one and only Prof—

units.rawText: Lying on a livestream isn't a great habit. I first met you when Evelyn hauled you off to solitary for causing a public disturbance.

units.rawText: After that, you shoved a questionnaire at me, criticized the Oasis's network with some snarky comments, and tried to nab Antonina's potato chips.

units.rawText: Ah! Crap! I lost track because you interrupted me! Aaaahhh! Professor, you ruined the vibe! This was supposed to be a heartfelt stream! Ahhh... It's too off the rails now... Anyway!
